subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu officially accept bot-authored messages by default and deterministically inject the bot sender's mention on automatic replies while leaving message-tool sends author-controlled?
rationale: This changes user-visible bot admission and delivery policy, adds configuration defaults, and can affect existing multi-bot workflows; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor current policy
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accepting bots, retain default loop protection, and guarantee the sender mention only on automatic replies after conflicts and upgrade proof are refreshed.

options.title: Require explicit bot opt-in
options.body: Change the default so bot-authored messages are ignored or mention-gated unless operators explicitly enable broader bot conversations.

options.title: Narrow mention handling
options.body: Land only payload-aware explicit mention normalization and defer automatic bot admission and deterministic sender injection to separate product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current policy
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accepting bots, retain default loop protection, and guarantee the sender mention only on automatic replies after conflicts and upgrade proof are refreshed.
